provenance.source: User-provided values in the approved growth plan plus a read-only App Store Connect and Play Console recheck on 2026-08-28

search_observations.note: The approved plan described the rank as approximately 81. The automated monitor establishes its own exact comparable series.

reproducibility_checks.interpretation: Not a contradiction: Apple's conversion rate uses total downloads and pre-orders divided by unique device impressions, while the supplied values are first-time downloads and unqualified impressions. The missing numerator and denominator must be imported before comparison.
The supplied 40.82% has no attached denominator or report definition and is preserved only as reported.
Directional only until installation and first-launch populations and date windows are confirmed comparable.

known_gaps: No raw App Store Connect or Play Console export is attached; the recheck is a read-only console observation.
Country, acquisition source, device, and app-version breakdowns are absent.
The reported conversion rates cannot be reproduced from the supplied counts.
D7 retention, DAU/MAU denominator, ratings average, iOS sessions, and user-loss rate are missing; Play ratings/vitals are suppressed as insufficient data.
The single iOS 1.0.1 crash on 2026-08-25 has no local crash report or stack trace; its device breakdown is suppressed as insufficient data.
